## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 9, 2026 - Jul 26, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _April H_, Jul 26, 2026, 1/5: "as long as you can afford the subscription the app is good. if you can't then the ads get aggravating especially being at the top of chat. it makes it to where you can not see what you type after a few lines. here lately, I can chat for a few paragraphs then it stop responding. have to close app and restart it. a few more paragraphs then it quits responding. have to close and restart again. very annoying. if they would get rid of ads at the top of messages then it would be ok. need to fix bugs."
            2. _LilyCat382_, Jul 25, 2026, 1/5: "Chai used to be a daily break. You could just chat, make stories and be creative. Today, bugs, arbitrary message limits and constant subscription notices dominate the app. Sometimes you have hundreds of messages, then suddenly 0 with no explanation. It's sad to see how an app with so much potential and a loyal community has lost so much quality. I don't want to use the app anymore, it's no use, you can't chat anymore. Please bring back the old Chai."
            3. _Hayden R._, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "the only issue is the filter😕 its so annoying when i try to make like a story or whatever n stuff, the filter just like ruins it all... i mean, the underage thing i get, but the others? nah"
